originalSnapshot.snapshotNote: Original template investigation snapshot; the later B7 evidence snapshot is recorded separately in enemy-reference.json.

decisions: B2: r5 explicitly opts into fresh latent41/TPA evidence for one basic unmatchable color/turn on enemy 200974. Require a first native-order isolated fire/wood four, then the blocked color in an existing-orb cascade; other five colors remain first-removal. Ordinary shared spinner phases only; no fishing, extra skills or extra puzzles. After-turn clear is required but is not attributed solely to the latent.

B7: up to two original attacks with exact native enemy roster; one additional board only for dead 200038 and living 210524 at <=50% HP. Fresh coverage and unchanged enemy/target evidence are required. Full clear can advance directly.
B12: check native body HP <=50% before each of the two remaining attack boards, proceeding directly to Solomon if the threshold was reached early.
B13: hold the Keisy loop until B14; restore uncovered absorption with an actual Solomon cast and native bypass result; finish with Atori, Diena, Riku, Atori in one board.

B14: hold Keisy on the first board, require its native-ready resize on the second, then reserve native-ready Solomon before finishing. This follows AppMedia rather than spending Solomon on B14 resize.

B15: require Solomon for active unmatchable, confirm its removal before planning, then use Riku and Atori. No B15 multi-color latent recovery is enabled; the final Riku stage remains bounded to two boards including stalls.

Execution history freezes separate native enemy identity/HP/alive/target evidence before search, before release and after the settled acknowledged turn. Generation, turn and battle identity bind the result; cached observations never authorize actions.
The B2 unmatchableRecovery key requires 0.5.57 or later with r5 support. Delivered 0.5.56 accepts r4 only; older imported profiles remain unchanged.

Single-player, exact native skills, native receipts, bounded gestures and the consumed-run restart restriction remain in force. Damage, survival, cooldown continuity and full device clear are not verified.
verificationScope: Windows portable regression passed; recorded B4 ordinary search acceptance failed. Full macOS/iPhoneOS/GUI results pending the manual CI. No delivery.
